findings.en_sentence: The Conques Formation ecosystem is one of only two known instances where a pareiasaurid, specifically Pareisactus, coexisted with hadrosaurids.
findings.es_sentence: El ecosistema de la Formación Conques es uno de los dos únicos registros conocidos de coexistencia entre un pareiasáurido, concretamente Pareisactus, y hadrosáuridos.
findings.problem: Pareisactus is a rhabdodontid ornithopod, not a pareiasaurid (Permian parareptiles); also repeats the previous sentence.
findings.correct: Delete (the rhabdodontid sentence just before already says this).

findings.en_sentence: Adynomosaurus lived in the upper Maastrichtian stage.
findings.es_sentence: Adynomosaurus vivió en el piso maastrichtiense superior.
findings.problem: Contradicts the early Maastrichtian age given on the same page; Costa de les Solanes is late early Maastrichtian (eswiki itself says 'finales del Maastrichtiano inferior' in its intro).
findings.checked_in: F041/F053 vs F001/F026; eswiki intro vs Descubrimiento; Prieto-Márquez et al. 2019

findings.en_sentence: Adynomosaurus belongs to the subfamily Arenysaurini.
findings.es_sentence: Adynomosaurus pertenece a la subfamilia Arenysaurini.
findings.problem: Arenysaurini is a tribe within Lambeosaurinae, not a subfamily; and it is one study's result (PBDB parent), stated as settled fact while the page says relationships are unresolved.
findings.correct: One study placed Adynomosaurus in Arenysaurini, a tribe of lambeosaurines, with other European taxa and Ajnabia.

findings.en_sentence: In a phylogenetic analysis, Adynomosaurus emerged in a soft polytomy with the genera Aralosaurus, Canardia, Jaxartosaurus, Tsintaosaurus, and Pararhabdodon as the base of the family.
findings.es_sentence: En un análisis filogenético, Adynomosaurus surgió en una politomía suave junto a los géneros Aralosaurus, Canardia, Jaxartosaurus, Tsintaosaurus y Pararhabdodon, formando la base de la familia.
findings.problem: The original analysis recovered this polytomy at the base of Lambeosaurinae (a subfamily), not of the family Hadrosauridae; these are basal lambeosaurines.
findings.correct: ...in a polytomy at the base of Lambeosaurinae with Aralosaurus, Canardia, Jaxartosaurus, Tsintaosaurus and Pararhabdodon.
findings.checked_in: F049 (eswiki Clasificación); Prieto-Márquez et al. 2019; knowledge

findings.en_sentence: The genus Adynomosaurus was named by Prieto-Márquez et al. in 2018.
findings.es_sentence: El género Adynomosaurus fue nombrado por Prieto-Márquez y colaboradores en 2018.
findings.problem: Contradicts the earlier sentence saying it was named in 2019; the paper appeared online in late 2018 but is in Cretaceous Research vol. 96 (2019), usually cited as 2019.
findings.correct: Use one date consistently: named by Prieto-Márquez et al. (2019).
findings.checked_in: F002 (enwiki intro) vs F028 (eswiki taxobox); knowledge

findings.en_sentence: As a lambeosaur, Adynomosaurus possessed a long skull equipped with a beak, complex teeth, and a nasal cranial crest filled with hollow passages.
findings.es_sentence: Como lambeosaurino, Adynomosaurus poseía un cráneo largo equipado con un pico, dientes complejos y una cresta nasal craneal rellena de pasajes huecos.
findings.problem: No skull is known; the source infers these traits ('would have had'), skull/beak/teeth from being a hadrosaur and only the crest from being a lambeosaur. Stated as observed fact.
findings.correct: As a hadrosaur it would have had a long beaked skull and complex teeth and, if a lambeosaurine, a hollow crest formed by the nasal bones.

findings.en_sentence: It is unknown whether the replacement of local herbivores by lambeosaurs was due to direct competition or environmental changes creating a void for them.
findings.es_sentence: No se sabe si el reemplazo de herbívoros locales por lambeosaurinos se debió a una competencia directa o a cambios ambientales que crearon un vacío para ellos.
findings.problem: Refers to a faunal turnover (rhabdodontids/nodosaurids replaced by hadrosaurs in the late Maastrichtian) the page never introduces; and it is repeated by the next-but-one sentence.
findings.correct: Introduce the turnover once and keep only one of the two sentences.

findings.en_sentence: It is debated whether the replacement of herbivorous dinosaur faunas in southwestern Europe was caused directly by competition with lambeosaurines or by environmental changes that created a vacuum for hadrosaurids.
findings.es_sentence: Se discute si el reemplazo de las faunas de dinosaurios herbívoros en el suroeste de Europa fue causado directamente por competencia con lambeosaurinos o por cambios ambientales que generaron un vacío para los hadrosáuridos.

findings.en_sentence: Isotope analysis of dinosaur eggshells from the formation indicated a humid environment with an average air temperature of 21 °C.
findings.es_sentence: El análisis de isótopos de cáscaras de huevo de dinosaurio procedentes de la formación reveló un ambiente húmedo con una temperatura media del aire de 21 °C.
findings.problem: Repeats the previous sentence almost word for word.

findings.en_sentence: The fossil locality Costa de les Solanes in the Conques Formation was first discovered in 2012 in a wheat field in the village of Basturs, Catalonia.
findings.es_sentence: La localidad fósil Costa de les Solanes, perteneciente a la Formación Conques, fue descubierta inicialmente en 2012 en un campo de trigo del pueblo de Basturs, Cataluña.
findings.problem: Repeats the discovery sentence two lines earlier; also the source says the site is next to ('by'/'junto a') a wheat field, not in it.
findings.correct: Merge into one sentence: the Costa de les Solanes locality (Conques Formation), found in 2012 next to a wheat field at Basturs.

findings.en_sentence: Adynomosaurus lived during the Maastrichtian stage, between 72.2 and 66 million years ago.
findings.es_sentence: Adynomosaurus habitó durante el piso maastrichtiense, hace entre 72,2 y 66 millones de años.
findings.problem: Third statement of the age in the same section; the stage range is not the taxon's age (early Maastrichtian, ~70 Ma).
findings.correct: Fold into the first age sentence: early Maastrichtian (the Maastrichtian spans 72.2–66 Ma).

findings.en_sentence: Despite these unique traits, Adynomosaurus was anatomically indistinguishable from other hadrosaurid dinosaurs in many aspects, such as vertebrae, humerus, femur, tibia, and metatarsals.
findings.es_sentence: A pesar de estas singularidades, en numerosos aspectos Adynomosaurus no presentaba diferencias anatómicas respecto a otros dinosaurios hadrosáuridos, ya fuera en vértebras, húmero, fémur, tibia o metatarsianos.
findings.problem: 'These unique traits' refers to nothing: the preceding sentences list generic hadrosaur/lambeosaur traits; the unique scapula is introduced only in the next section.
findings.correct: Drop 'Despite these unique traits' or place after the scapula sentence.

findings.en_sentence: The tooth crowns of this animal are approximately three times taller than they are wide.
findings.problem: Sentence present in English but missing from the Spanish text.
findings.correct: Add: 'Las coronas dentales son unas tres veces más altas que anchas.'

findings.en_sentence: The species name arcanus means 'secret' or 'occult', referring to the sparse and uninformative hadrosaur fossil record in the South-Central Pyrenean Basin.
findings.es_sentence: El epíteto específico arcanus significa 'oculto' o 'secreto', aludiendo al registro fósil escaso y poco informativo de hadrosaurios en la cuenca pirenaico-central del sur.
findings.problem: 'cuenca pirenaico-central del sur' is a garbled calque; the established Spanish term is 'cuenca surpirenaica central' (or 'pirenaica centro-sur', as eswiki has).
findings.correct: ...de hadrosaurios de la cuenca surpirenaica central.

findings.en_sentence: Based on modern crocodylian myology, researchers surmise that the reduced scapulae of Adynomosaurus meant reduced arm musculature.
findings.es_sentence: Basándose en la miología de cocodrilos modernos, los investigadores deducen que las escápalas reducidas de Adynomosaurus implicaban una musculatura de las patas delanteras disminuida.
findings.correct: ...los investigadores suponen que las escápulas reducidas...

findings.en_sentence: The Conques Formation ecosystem represents one of only two known instances where a rhabdodontid (Pareisactus) coexisted with hadrosaurs.
findings.es_sentence: El ecosistema de la Formación Conques representa uno de los dos únicos casos conocidos donde un rhabdodontido (Pareisactus) coexistió con hadrosáuridos.

findings.en_sentence: The formation is considered to represent a tide-dominated delta adjacent to meandering river channels influenced by interior tides.
findings.es_sentence: La formación se considera que representa un delta dominado por mareas adyacente a canales de río meandriformes influenciados por mareas interiores.
findings.problem: Ungrammatical anacoluthon calqued from the English passive.
findings.correct: Se considera que la formación representa un delta dominado por las mareas...

findings.en_sentence: It is debated whether Adynomosaurus belongs within Hadrosauridae, with some studies placing it in Tsintaosaurini and others outside the family entirely.
findings.es_sentence: Se debate si Adynomosaurus pertenece a Hadrosauridae, con algunos estudios ubicándolo en Tsintaosaurini y otros excluyéndolo de la familia por completo.
findings.problem: 'con algunos estudios ubicándolo' is an English 'with + -ing' calque.
findings.correct: ...: algunos estudios lo sitúan en Tsintaosaurini y otros, fuera de la familia.

findings.en_sentence: As a lambeosaur, Adynomosaurus possessed a long skull equipped with a beak, complex teeth, and a nasal cranial crest filled with hollow passages.
findings.es_sentence: Como lambeosaurino, Adynomosaurus poseía un cráneo largo equipado con un pico, dientes complejos y una cresta nasal craneal rellena de pasajes huecos.
findings.problem: 'rellena de pasajes huecos' calques 'hollow passages'; a crest is hollow, not filled with hollow things.
findings.correct: ...una cresta formada por los huesos nasales, con conductos internos huecos.
